design_issues.screen: Reports page (all tabs) on initial mount
issues: Recharts warns 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' momentarily before container measures. Cosmetic only; charts render correctly after mount. Consider setting an explicit min-height on ResponsiveContainer wrapper.

action_items: (Optional) Suppress the Recharts width/height ResponsiveContainer warnings by giving the containing div a fixed height or minHeight.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~2340 lines — router split (reports/expenses/bills/inquiries modules) is overdue for maintainability.

In /api/reports/expenses the range filter compares expense.date (YYYY-MM-DD string) against f_iso/t_iso — the function slices [:10] before comparing which is correct, but the whole approach relies on string ordering of ISO dates; fine, just document intent with a comment.
The expense delete endpoint is authorised by any authenticated user (not admin-only). Consider whether employees should be able to delete expense records — currently they can.

/api/reports/sales computes 'category_totals' with taxable/tax back-calculated from the line's inclusive price using gst_percent — if a legacy bill uses top-level gst_percent instead of per-item, the numbers will roll into 'other' with rate=0 and thus tax=0. Not a bug, but a data-source caveat worth noting in a comment.

business.xlsx endpoint calls sales_report/gstr3b_report/payment_mode_report/expense_report as internal awaitable functions — clean pattern, but note that if any of them raises HTTPException the caller doesn't wrap it, so the xlsx endpoint could return an auth/500 midway through building — acceptable.
PrintBill receipt mode correctly hides GSTIN/FSSAI/HSN/GST columns; no regression on invoice mode.

bill-fullscreen-qr is shown for both pending and paid bills (Bills.jsx line 176 inside bill-pay-card which is only rendered when payment_status==='pending'). Ours worked on the tested bill because it was pending — confirm this matches product intent (probably yes: only pending bills need a QR to collect payment).
